subject: Request: Community Sprint Credits & 3-month Trial for TokenFlow Maintainers
messages:
From: Cassie Liu <cassie@tokenflow.org>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Community sprint — request for credits + trial extension

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking a look. TokenFlow is organizing a month-long community sprint (Aug 15 - Sep 15) focused on inference optimization and documentation for TensorToken integration. We've got ~25 active maintainers who will need API access to run benchmarks and CI for sample apps.

Request: 100k free token credits + 3-month trial extension for all maintainers (provisioned via single org admin). We'll provide a short public recap and social shoutouts to Redwood. Attached is a brief form with the maintainer roster and the sprint plan.

Attachments: credit_request_tokenflow_Q3.pdf, maintainers_roster.csv

Would appreciate a quick yes/no this week so we can post the partner announcement.

Best,
Cassie Liu
Lead Maintainer — TokenFlow
https://tokenflow.org
